 Order

The petitioner is the owner of plot bearing No.42, door No.235, Municipal No.2-13-188/42, in Sy.No.32/1B, 32/3B and 32/3A situated at Ushamani Nagar, Sharanabasaveshwara Camp, Ward No.10, Gangavathi, in all measuring 3000 sq.feet (50' x 60') purchased through a registered sale deed dated 05.02.2001.
2.

An extent of land measuring 1,500 sq.feet out of 3,000 sq.feet was proposed to be acquired for the purpose of formation of railway line from Munirabad to Mahaboob Nagar which culminated in passing of an award.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The petitioner's grievance is that though 1,500 sq.feet land was sought to be acquired, however,
the entire extent of land is utilized for the purpose of construction of railway line.

Respondent No.1 has addressed a communication dated 10.07.2015 to the Commissioner of City Municipal Council,
Gangavathi, stating that the entire extent of land measuring 3,000 sq.feet is used for the purpose of formation of the railway line.
Similarly the Town Municipal Council has communicated to the Special Land Acquisition Officer stating that the entire extent of land measuring 3,000 sq.feet is utilized.

4. Learned Addl. Government Advocate for state on instruction submitted that that in pursuance to the representation submitted by the petitioner, fresh acquisition process would be initiated for acquiring the excess extent of land measuring 1,500 sq.feet and pass the award in accordance with law, if excess land is utilized.

5. Therefore, it is expedient to dispose of the writ petition directing the respondents No.1 and 3 to consider the representations dated 24.01.2015 and 28.03.2022, submitted NC: 2024:KHC-D:1144 by the petitioner at Annexures-D and E and pass appropriate order in accordance with law, within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order.
6. Before passing any order, respondents No.1 to 3 shall notify the petitioner as well as respondents No.2 beneficiary.

Sd/-
